reauth_account.title: Sign in to Eleven Energy again

data_description.poll_interval_seconds: How often inverter data is fetched. Applied immediately.
data_description.device_label_override: Leave blank to use the product name the Eleven Energy API reports. Set to override the device-card title and model. Changing this triggers an integration reload.

not_loaded.message: Eleven Energy Plus is not loaded, so {service} cannot run.

set_work_mode_self_consumption.name: Self Consumption
set_work_mode_self_consumption.description: Solar covers the house, surplus charges the battery, and once it is full the surplus is exported. The battery makes up any shortfall. Setting any work mode switches the Eleven Energy optimiser off until Reset Work Mode is sent.

device_id.name: Inverter
device_id.description: Which inverter to act on. Optional on a site with one inverter; on a site with more, a call without it is refused rather than guessed.

percent_to_battery.name: Percentage To Battery
percent_to_battery.description: How much of the surplus solar to store rather than export, as a percentage. Leave unset to store all of it.

set_work_mode_force_charge.name: Grid Charge
set_work_mode_force_charge.description: Charge the battery from the grid at a set power until it reaches a target. Once there, the house is supplied from the grid until the mode is changed. The Eleven Energy optimiser stays off until Reset Work Mode is sent.

device_id.name: Inverter
device_id.description: Which inverter to act on. Optional on a site with one inverter; on a site with more, a call without it is refused rather than guessed.

target_power.name: Target Power
target_power.description: Battery charge power in kW. A lower rate may be used if the battery is current limited, such as at a low state of charge.

target_percent.name: Target SoC %
target_percent.description: The state of charge to stop charging at.

set_work_mode_grid_export.name: Grid Export
set_work_mode_grid_export.description: Discharge the battery to the grid at a set power until it reaches a target. After that the house is still supplied from the battery, but surplus solar is exported rather than stored. The Eleven Energy optimiser stays off until Reset Work Mode is sent.

device_id.name: Inverter
device_id.description: Which inverter to act on. Optional on a site with one inverter; on a site with more, a call without it is refused rather than guessed.

target_power.name: Target Power
target_power.description: Battery discharge power in kW. This is battery power, not power at the meter: with 1 kW of house load, 5 kW here puts about 4 kW on the grid.

target_percent.name: Target SoC %
target_percent.description: The state of charge to stop discharging at.

include_excess_solar.name: Add Surplus Solar
include_excess_solar.description: Export surplus solar on top of the discharge power rather than storing it.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.description: Allow exceeding the usual export ceiling where the connection permits it. Leave off unless you have been told otherwise.

set_work_mode_pv_export.name: Excess PV Export
set_work_mode_pv_export.description: Like Self Consumption, but surplus solar is exported before it is stored. If more solar is available than can be exported, the remainder goes to the battery. The Eleven Energy optimiser stays off until Reset Work Mode is sent.

device_id.name: Inverter
device_id.description: Which inverter to act on. Optional on a site with one inverter; on a site with more, a call without it is refused rather than guessed.

set_work_mode_idle_battery.name: Idle Battery
set_work_mode_idle_battery.description: Hold the battery where it is. Charging and discharging can be allowed separately. The Eleven Energy optimiser stays off until Reset Work Mode is sent.

device_id.name: Inverter
device_id.description: Which inverter to act on. Optional on a site with one inverter; on a site with more, a call without it is refused rather than guessed.

allow_charging.name: Allow Charging
allow_charging.description: Permit charging the battery from surplus solar.

allow_discharging.name: Allow Discharging
allow_discharging.description: Permit discharging the battery to supply the house.

set_work_mode_target_soc.name: Target State Of Charge
set_work_mode_target_soc.description: Reach a target state of charge within a deadline, working out the rate from the house load as it goes. Once the target is reached the system runs in Excess PV Export until the mode is changed. The Eleven Energy optimiser stays off until Reset Work Mode is sent.

device_id.name: Inverter
device_id.description: Which inverter to act on. Optional on a site with one inverter; on a site with more, a call without it is refused rather than guessed.

target_soc.name: Target SoC %
target_soc.description: The state of charge to aim for.

target_minutes.name: Target Minutes
target_minutes.description: How long it has to get there, in whole minutes (1 to 1440).

max_charge_power.name: Max Charge Power
max_charge_power.description: A ceiling in kW while charging. A lower rate may be used; this is only a maximum.

max_discharge_power.name: Max Discharge Power
max_discharge_power.description: A ceiling in kW while discharging. A lower rate may be used; this is only a maximum.

set_work_mode_reset.name: Reset Work Mode
set_work_mode_reset.description: Hand control back to the system. If a schedule was in effect when the mode was changed it resumes, otherwise automatic operation does. Send this when your automation has finished - until you do, the Eleven Energy optimiser stays switched off.

device_id.name: Inverter
device_id.description: Which inverter to act on. Optional on a site with one inverter; on a site with more, a call without it is refused rather than guessed.
